information: The competition will be held in multiple locations, across the globe. Please pay attention to the date and time zone of your location! Locations may be added until December 6th 23:59 UTC so if there isn't a location near you yet contact your local Delegate. For all locations with a field labelled TBD, registrations will be accepted in the order they were submitted in after the location is finalised. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI4NzM3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--213c996ac46c7009a3c75a04e1c6fd6b3f6dc603/fmcunderthemistletoe2025.png)
